Interface Distribution

All Superinterfaces:
StorableDistribution
All Known Implementing Classes:
Batch, Burst, CoxianDistr, DeterministicDistr, Empirical, Erlang, Exponential, GammaDistr, HyperExp, Lognormal, MAPDistr, MMPP2Distr, Normal, Pareto, PhaseTypeDistr, Poisson, Replayer, StudentT, Uniform, Weibull
public interface Distribution extends StorableDistribution
This is the Distribution abstract class, which is the interface of all distributions.

  • Method Details

    • nextRand

      double nextRand(Parameter p) throws IncorrectDistributionParameterException
      This method is used to ask all the distribution to return a new random number distributed according to the distribution name.
      Parameters:
      p - parameter of the distribution.
      Returns:
      double with the next random number from the sequence.
      Throws:
      IncorrectDistributionParameterException

    • pdf

      double pdf(double x, Parameter p) throws IncorrectDistributionParameterException
      This method is used to obtain from the distribution its probability distribution function evaluated where required by the user.
      Parameters:
      x - double indicating where to evaluate the pdf.
      p - parameter of the distribution.
      Returns:
      double with the probability distribution function evaluated in x.
      Throws:
      IncorrectDistributionParameterException
